traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements for Story 020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION are implemented and verified: - File-level @supports annotations are required in test files and auto-templated when missing. - describe/context blocks in test files must include a story reference matching a configurable pattern. - it/test names must start with a [REQ-XXX] requirement prefix, with safe normalization auto-fixes for malformed but recognizable prefixes. - Test file detection, multi-framework support (Jest, Mocha-style context), and deep story/requirement validation are implemented via dedicated helpers and existing core rules. - The rule is registered in the plugin, enabled in both recommended and strict presets at error severity, and documented in user-docs with behavior, options, and examples. - Dedicated RuleTester coverage plus the full Jest test run confirm correct behavior, integration, and performance.
Based on the current code, tests, and documentation, this story is fully implemented and passes.
